fresh_ep72_architecture_check.rejection: Destination-rank incidence has no anchor-independent coefficient that maps it to the measured total MTP step service. Applying it to the complete service would turn a disclosed component overlay into measured latency attribution.

attenuation_ruling.policy_basis: Incomplete data-parallel-attention integration and open depth linearity are simLLM mechanism residuals, not benchmark-condition biases. Policy rule five forbids attenuating them away.

depth_doctrine.treatment: The same declared linear extrapolation doctrine as the standard decode cell. No depth fit or depth attenuation is permitted.

fit_ruling.reason: The MTP row introduces no fitted parameter and the run-3 calibration-only fit already governs every inherited prefill row.

step_to_token_doctrine.batch_mapping: The disclosure's batch 128 per node maps over eight GPUs to batch 16 per GPU, matching the measured physical cell.
step_to_token_doctrine.integration_caveat: The disclosure calls this simulated MTP and states that MTP integration with data-parallel attention is incomplete. The run prices only the disclosed simulated accounting and makes no production MTP integration claim.
step_to_token_doctrine.simulated_semantics: One ordinary decode token plus one simulated speculative token is emitted for each request in the measured step. Rejection and replay are not modeled.
